text: Compared with direct detection, what does balanced coherent (homodyne) detection provide?
choices: A 3 dB SNR improvement plus cancellation of laser relative-intensity noise (RIN) in the balanced subtraction
A 10 dB SNR improvement but added RIN
explanation: Mixing the signal with a strong local oscillator gives SNR_coherent = RP_s/(eB) versus RP_s/(2eB) for direct detection — a 3 dB gain — and the balanced pair subtracts common-mode laser RIN. It does not remove shot noise (it is shot-noise limited), and it fundamentally requires a phase-coherent local-oscillator laser.
